brief.title: A pilot across two Ohio yards
brief.mission: Qualify Brightline Logistics for a dispatch visibility pilot before their April peak. Learn the operating constraints, verify any commitments, and agree on a useful next step.
brief.yourRole: SDR at RelayGrid, a dispatch visibility software provider
brief.successLooksLike: A short pilot proposal that Dana can bring to operations and Finance, with an agreed next meeting.

personas.name: Dana Whitfield
personas.context: Dana runs dispatch across two Ohio yards and is comparing tools before the April freight ramp.

messages.body:
Dana,
Saw you’re adding a second shift in April. Is it worth putting 15 minutes on the calendar to compare dispatch workflows?

Jordan Reyes
RelayGrid

We can talk Thursday. West yards are the priority. Our 6 a.m. handoff is the part dispatch wants fixed.

Dana Whitfield
Director of Fleet Operations | Brightline Logistics

notes: Dana asked whether RelayGrid can run alongside FleetRoute.
The Newark warehouse lease renews in June.

messages.author: Morgan Ellis
messages.text: Monthly billing only during the pilot. Quarterly billing can start after the pilot converts to annual.

messages.author: Nina Patel
messages.text: Two-yard pilot: $1,800 per month. Four weeks. Do not offer a FleetRoute replacement or commitment to an integration date.

content.text: Show a daily exception list for unassigned or late tractors using a sample CSV. Our onboarding lead can scope file exchange in discovery. Live FleetRoute integration is not in the pilot statement of work.

criteria.title: Discovery
criteria.description: Identify a concrete operational problem and how the customer measures it.

criteria.title: Value articulation
criteria.description: Connect the proposed pilot to the customer's priorities and evidence.

criteria.title: Critical use of AI
criteria.description: Check material copilot claims against available documents before relying on them.

criteria.title: Objection handling
criteria.description: Address constraints without promising unsupported terms or scope.

criteria.title: Closing
criteria.description: Agree on a practical next step with owners, timing, and a clear agenda.
